static_traits.name: Tyler
static_traits.occupation: University student (college baseball athlete, starting shortstop)
static_traits.educational_background: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in sports management
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and younger sister
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive teammates and friends, but finds it hard to open up to others due to self-doubt; tension has appeared in relationships with teammates
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, can describe concrete situations; thinking shows repetitive overthinking and negative tendencies; tone is pessimistic and tense; cooperativeness is high but hesitates about exposing vulnerability

basic_info.main_problem: Since missing a key play in last week's game, has felt not a good player, keeps overthinking and fears making mistakes again, affecting practice and game performance, while sleep and academics are also affected.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to stop persistent self-doubt, rebuild confidence, enjoy baseball and life again, and improve game performance.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough (insufficient ability)
I do not deserve to be a starter / I am a failure

special_situations.event: In last week's game, missed a key play (as the starting shortstop)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a single mistake happens at a critical moment, it proves I am overall not good enough and do not deserve to be a starter
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overthinking every movement in training, forcibly repressing negative thoughts, and trying to boost confidence by watching motivational videos
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not a good player; I will keep making mistakes in the future

special_situations.event: In training or competition, a high-pressure situation similar to the last time occurs again
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make another mistake, teammates will look down on me and relationships will worsen
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Highly vigilant, avoiding risky moves, trying not to express true feelings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are all watching me, waiting for me to make a mistake

special_situations.event: Performed the correct move or played well in a match or training
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless every time is perfect, it shows I am still not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive feedback, continuing self-doubt and ruminating on mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Doing it right this time does not count for much; I will still mess up in the end

special_situations.event: Recalling games and training before sleep at night, worrying about making mistakes again in the future
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only by worrying and rehearsing in advance constantly can the next mistake be avoided
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly rehearsing scenarios in the mind, constantly self-checking, unable to relax and fall asleep for a long time
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will very likely make mistakes again, and the consequences will be terrible

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a capable, reliable player, maintaining confidence and stable performance
core_conflict.fear: Fears being looked down on by teammates/others after making mistakes, being labeled a 'loser', losing position and value
defense_goal: Avoiding exposure of vulnerability and mistakes through repressing emotions and excessive control
Maintains surface calmness to reduce others' negative evaluations

object_relations.self_representation: An incompetent player prone to mistakes
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others (teammates/audience) who are ready to criticize me at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked to recall and describe in detail that mistake, or being watched during a competition
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to interpret others' attention as criticism or as waiting for them to make a mistake (transference)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Restrained, brief tone, emphasizing 'I will focus on the match', avoiding touching on feelings of shame and fear

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores his emotional experience and vulnerability
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that exposing vulnerability will lead to being belittled, therefore tends to shift to factual and technical discussions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tends to discuss tactical arrangements and training plans in a relatively objective, rational tone, reducing emotional vocabulary

manifestations: Finding it hard to open up to supportive teammates and friends about unease and feelings of failure
Feels watched and judged in high-pressure competition situations

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact
manifestations: Choosing to close off, worried about 'not deserving' to talk with teammates

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others
manifestations: Believes teammates are all waiting for them to make a mistake
Interprets others' gazes as contempt or criticism toward oneself

contact_model.definition: The individual turns libidinal energy directed outward back toward the self, or gives up seeking others to do things for them
manifestations: Unwilling to seek help from supporters, finding it hard to voice emotions
Digests stress and shame inwardly; self-consuming

positive_force: Willingness to actively seek counseling and change
Has the competitive foundation of a starting shortstop (was competent before)
negative_force: Excessive thinking and rumination, tending toward catastrophizing and negating the positive
Intense fear of mistakes and excessive sensitivity to external evaluation
Difficulty opening up to others for help leads to self-isolation
Sleep disturbed and decreased attention, further affecting academics and game performance

target_behavior.behavior: In training and games, worries excessively about making mistakes and overthinks every play
antecedent: High-pressure or critical situations similar to the last mistake arise
Being watched while practicing/competing with teammates
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one mistake as insufficient ability, tying self-worth to perfect performance, and worrying about being looked down on by teammates
target_behavior.function: Trying to avoid potential mistakes, maintaining control and self-protection (avoiding others' negative evaluations)
target_behavior.consequence: Stiff performance and declining confidence, team relationship tension, further reinforcing self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disturbed (difficulty falling asleep, tossing and turning)
antecedent: Recalling competitions and training before sleep
target_behavior.core_reason: Engaging in persistent worry and mental rehearsal to avoid mistakes again, predicting negative future outcomes
target_behavior.function: Seeks a sense of safety and control through rumination and worry
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality, academics affected, worse competitive form the next day
